nearNote: near variants the stylesheets paint, each in the role its property allows (tokenize.mjs --suggest --near 24): added as palettes, read by a person
t4PlaceholdersNote: each placeholder of css/tpl/theme.tpl.css and pattern.tpl.css reads the slot in the role the t4SiteCss build gave its value in the generated sheet, one per kind of property where the value plays two (__color_primary: the accent fill of buttons, fg-2 as heading text; __color_secondary: accent-hover fill, fg text). pattern.tpl.css is written once per palette: its placeholders take the light palette's roles, the dark palette painting only the kept bands (topbar, slideshow, section 6, footnav), where the slot's colours are reset and T4's values show. T4 rewrites media/t4/css/<style id>.css whenever its content changes, so the tokenized sheets the 1.0.1 build shipped with their hashes held on a fresh site but went back to literals once T4 wrote them again (11/10/2026: sheets emptied and the page asked for twice, 4/12, page ground and call to action the template's under every system, link text 1.1:1 under Moxie)
t4SiteNote: T4 writes each template style's colours into media/t4/css/<style id>.css as literals and rewrites the file whenever its content changes: the colours reach the slot through the placeholders of css/tpl/*.tpl.css (t4Placeholders), never through the generated file

textNote: the menu paints its links rgba(0, 0, 0, .7), a literal no palette names: they take the page text (selectors.pageText); the intro band (.bg-primary, T4's primary) and the Join Our Team tile (an accent-hover fill) carry the accent's own text colour (selectors.onAccent) — white on a light system accent read 1.94:1 in round 1; the wordmark and client logos are dark-ink images, inverted with hues kept under a dark system (selectors.inkImages)
templateVarsNote: the template's own T4 theme colours (params/typelist-theme.xml), each in the role the template's palette gives its value; pass-joomla.mjs
bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; blocks of the template’s own colour it was missing drafted 14/10/2026 off its home page and the inner pages the sweep measured (scripts/bands.mjs --draft --fills): the visual review saw them keep the template colour, or white words on a ground that took a light accent
sideNote: the services page lists its items in Bootstrap rows of flexible columns (.blog .items-row .col, flex 1 1 0% with wrapping) that stack on a phone only because each column’s narrowest content is wider than half the screen in the template’s faces: a system’s narrower face let two of them share a 390px line, so the list went two-up on a phone (visual review 14/10/2026). Under a system each column is at least 240px wide (or the whole row), so a phone shows one per line and the desktop’s and tablet’s three-up stays; the inner pages’ photo title band (.t4-masthead.t4-palette-dark, drafted 14/10 as a fill) wears an ink of the system under its photo at 50%, so its overlay stays dark under a light system
